verdict.rationale: Trivy exposes a documented CLI (trivy-gh-1, trivy-gh-4) and an official MCP server (trivy-docs-7/11/13, trivy-probe-4) explicitly built for AI-native, natural-language driving of scans, which functions as a documented programmatic interface for agentic use. However, probes confirm no formal REST/OpenAPI public API exists (trivy-probe-3) and no machine-readable docs endpoint (trivy-probe-1/2), so 'API' access is limited to CLI/MCP rather than a conventional documented web API. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI/REST specification, independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability, and broader API documentation beyond the CLI/MCP plugin.
